I have over 5,000 hours on this game ever since I bought it in 2011. Garry's Mod is one of the games that I can honestly say changed my life.
I met some amazing people and created a great community that gave me a reason to come home everyday and ignore all the shit going on in my life. Everyone deserves that outlet and that's the environment Garry's Mod repeatedly offers me to this day.
This game is truly a piece of history in my eyes and will continue to be apart of one of my most played games. Until the day the Garry's Mod 2 comes out.

What's to say..? This game is my childhood. It came with the orange box when I purchased it alongside TF2 and Counter Strike on a CD all these years ago. Before steam completely moved to a digitized marketplace aside from their hardware.

Oddly enough it's RP demographic, (HL2RP for instance..) got me started on enjoying role-playing games. Despite it dying out now in recent years.

Aside from it's creative sandbox you can get lost for hours in, the creative talent of the workshop and scripting community is quite amazing.

The community however is quite toxic and it's nice to find a genuinely good server with a local community without it's undesirables, with a remote semblance of maturity. It's cheap, it's fun, it's great to play with friends-- I'd advise towards purchasing it and trying out the various gamemodes it has to offer.

Fun sandbox based game that you can play with your friends. i love the variety of gamemodes that are there to choose for players all around the world. i develop garry's mod servers, and its just so easy to find other nice players with the exception of hackers and douche bag server owners. 10/10 on the workshop addition, alot of sandbox games don't really feature it.....
There's just nothing better than choosing characters that you played in previous games by Valve and making them do adorable grins as they shoot rockets from their pelvis.

It's super fun to play and great for... generally anything. Making video's, creating game modes, etc. It's generally just the ultimate source game.

However, not that I've been able to play the previous version but from what I understand from some Youtubers who often did Gmod videos, Garrysmod 9 feels like a step backward. And although I have no experience to compare it to, I do see what they mean.

Some of the settings have been changed to be weird and other features were just outright removed.

However, do I still recommend it? Hell yes. Even if the 'downgrade' dumbed the experience down before I even got to experience it, it is still hella fun to play.

Garry's Mod is an amazing game where you can do almost anything you want in this game because of 1 thing. ADDONS. Addons is the main cource in this game. The addons are all workshop based and there are many addons you can do to full around with this amazing game. Spaceships,muskets? They got it. Pyramid maps, Mario Ragdolls? They got that too. Also one element that is great for keeping this game fun is the gamemodes. They have many gamemodes to choose from and also to play. There are games such as the hidden,Trouble in Terrorist Town, Multiplayer Slender. They got it all. But make sure you have half life 2 and Counter Strike source. These are one of the main elements for some maps textures and such. Valve made it so that you can use most Valve games and other games to add to Garry's mod for endless fun. I rate this game a 9.5/10
